snippet.title: Drowned Lake | Play the Demo | CRTime
snippet.description:
The strange disappearance of an amateur documentarian named Bento draws three strangers, each with their own motives and secrets, to a mysterious lake in rural Brazil. Explore the lake, find Bento, and continue his investigation.

Drowned Lake is a survival horror that combines exploration, fishing, and resource management, in a creeping mystery. Coming soon to XBOX Series X|S.

Play the demo and wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4335180/Drowned_Lake_Demo/
